about: Counts of key-relative chord patterns (1-4 chords) in the corpora below, for the chord suggestions in chord.sh. Aggregate statistics only: no piece can be reconstructed. Made by npm run study:rules (docs/rules.md).
sources: Bach chorales: When in Rome analyses (Gotham et al., CC BY-SA 4.0) with Craig Sapp’s Humdrum scores
DCML Distant Listening Corpus (Hentschel et al., CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)
OpenScore Lieder (CC0) with When in Rome analyses (CC BY-SA 4.0)
Rolling Stone 200 (de Clercq & Temperley, CC BY 4.0)
Weimar Jazz Database (Pfleiderer et al., ODbL)
